Additional textual sharing occurs with Kv 1.9 (*Satipaṭṭhānakathā*), Kv 6.5 (*Nirodhasamāpattikathā*), Kv 6.4 (*Āruppakathā*), Kv 6.6 (*Ākāsakathā*), and Kv 3.3 (*Vimuttikathā*) [DharmaNexus].
